title: NDC-1988 Desk ticket forms: the 6 requirement items checked by behaviour (layout "QA RT20 VR 1988 Layout", QA AO Dept A)
rows: Rule: type=Refund → show section "QA RT20 VR Refund section" + order mandatory. POST ticket type=Refund, no order / type=Question, no order
422 qa_rt20vr_order "QA RT20 VR order is required." / 201

422 VALIDATION_RULE_FAILED "QA RT20 VR: a Refund order number cannot start with BAD" / 201 / 201
PUT layout: Priority allowed_values [low, medium] (stored on the layout; field keeps 4). POST ticket on that layout priority=urgent
201 accepted; Create form still lists Low, Medium, High, Urgent; no layout setting in the UI (Field options are module-wide)
Layout field › Set Permission; Help Center form field definition keys
Only Read-only + profile Read/Edit; HC form field = key, label, required, hidden, default_value, help — no editable / read-only / hidden per field for customers
6 dependency maps l1→l2…l6→l7 (7 levels); ticket l1=A1,l2=B2; chain ok; l6=C6,l7=A7; map l7→l1
